conversation.text: Hi, I have two things: my AC is blowing warm and I want to get someone out, and I'd like to know if joining the maintenance plan would save me money on this.
For this demo, today is Friday 16 October 2026.

Per the Comfort Club Maintenance Plan overview (membership/comfort_club_overview.md), Comfort Club members get two seasonal tune-ups per year (one cooling, one heating), priority scheduling ahead of non-members, the $89 diagnostic fee waived on all service calls, 15% off all repairs (parts and labor), no after-hours dispatch fee on emergency calls, annual reminder and filter-change notifications, and $500 off any full system replacement.
Standard is $189 per year or $16.99 per month, and Plus is $269 per year and adds a water heater flush and inspection, a whole-home plumbing inspection, and 15% off plumbing repairs.
The documents do not say whether these benefits apply to a visit booked on the day of joining, so a team member confirms that when setting up the membership.
